# Welcome to Perth Roleplay!

> This is all the offical server documentation and information for Perth Roleplay. Please use the selections on the side to select the different documents. If you have any questions please don't hesitate to open a ticket.

- [Welcome to Perth Roleplay!](https://PRP-Docs.github.io/index.md): Welcome to Perth Roleplay!

## Guidelines

- [Community Guidelines](https://PRP-Docs.github.io/guidelines/community-guidelines.md): Below you will find our Discord Community Guidelines. Please be sure to read them carefully to avoid punishments, if you have any questions please open a ticket via our Discord server.
- [In Game Guidelines](https://PRP-Docs.github.io/guidelines/in-game-guidelines.md): Below you will find our in-game guidelines. Please be sure to read them carefully to avoid punishments, if you have any questions please open a ticket.
